headline: Happy Journey is now streaming on Prime Video: OTT release date and where to watch
dek: The Telugu film, starring Aamani, Jhansi, Annapoorna, arrived on Prime Video 8 weeks after opening in cinemas on 18 September.
paragraphs: Happy Journey is streaming on Prime Video in India from 13 November.
That is 56 days after its theatrical release on 18 September — 28 days slower than the typical 28 days for Telugu films, based on 13 recent releases tracked by New on OTT.

A group of seven women across generations set off on a spontaneous European getaway, leaving their everyday lives behind. Amid the chaos, laughter and picturesque landscapes, the journey becomes an unexpected celebration of freedom and friendship.
Directed by Abhiramm Naidu, starring Aamani, Jhansi, Annapoorna, Vamshidhar Kosgi Goud, Paayal Radhakrishna. The film runs 125 minutes and is certified U/A 13+.
New on OTT re-checks Prime Video's India listing every day; the page for Happy Journey has the latest on where to watch it.
title: Happy Journey
